title: DecisionTreeMetadata
description: Schema for metadata associated with a trained Decision Tree model.

model_id.description: Unique identifier for the model artifact.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of the decision tree.

training_dataset_version.description: SHA256 hash or version ID of the training dataset.

test_accuracy.description: Accuracy on the held-out test split.

feature_names.description: List of feature names used for training.

class_labels.description: List of class labels (expert IDs) the model predicts.

file_path.description: Relative path to the saved model file (e.g., .pkl).

sha256_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the model file for integrity verification.
